title: Quest Foglight for Databases runScript Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-92191)
description: CVE-2026-92191 is a high-severity vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases affecting the runScript function. It allows remote authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges due to incorrect authorization checks. This flaw requires authentication but does not require user interaction. No patch information is currently available.
